USA 290 (NROL-71) is a classified U.S. reconnaissance satellite operated by the National Reconnaissance Office (NRO). It launched on January 19, 2019, on a Delta IV Heavy rocket from Vandenberg Air Force Base, and is widely identified as an advanced KH-11 optical imaging satellite.
